focused_endpoint_report.scope: Independent exact Fraction enclosure endpoints, neighboring midpoint intervals and reciprocal endpoint RNE; directed MPFR for accepted/public negative powers. Hooks check exact first-square states and actual new trusted-cell calls. Every call checks ABI and bounded writes. Diagnostic image only; no complete qualification, general totality or hardware timing claim.

algebra_report.scope: Algebraic Q63 endpoint bounds, bounded32-bit arithmetic, same-binade cached midpoint differences and a guarded two-cell lemma. Source statements bind the inspected experiment. Requires independent ARM endpoint/MPFR and compiled-call-site qualification before adoption. No general pow termination or physical speed claim.

hard_profile.scope: Executed instructions, attributed to the nearest preceding typed function entry or ROM. Function extents and alias spelling make this a diagnostic partition, not a linker equivalence proof. Totals exactly match the independent instruction counter; results match the saved MPFR inputs. No device cycles or all-input speed claims.

earlier_GCC_matrix.scope: Executed ARM instructions on the prepared finite corpus, with typed 32-bit return masking. If sides_share_elf is false, owned production symbols and pinned diagnostic Qfplib symbols run on separate instances of the same Cortex-M0 emulator. When actual_bootrom is present, SDK ROM lookup initializers, wrappers and ROM bodies execute without intrinsic models. SIO division remains functionally modeled. These are not hardware cycles, cache comparisons, timings, or proof of speed parity.
